scenario.description: A maintenance manager must schedule the replacement of a central compressed-air dryer and finalize which production activities can continue during the outage, with input from quality, utilities, production control, and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: The central compressed-air dryer serving Lines 5 and 7 is due for desiccant replacement this week.
shared_context.S2: A portable compressor is available for temporary service during the dryer work.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final maintenance and production-control decision for the shutdown.
shared_context.S4: The plant's routine pre-shutdown review requires Maya to hear a response from quality, utilities, production control, and environmental health and safety before the work order is finalized.
shared_context.S5: The pre-shutdown checklist is reviewed in this order: quality, utilities, production control, and environmental health and safety; Maya finalizes the work order only after all four responses are recorded.

PF1.text: Colin's quality review found that Line 7's pneumatic process requires compressed air at a dew point of -40 degrees Celsius or lower, and the portable compressor cannot meet that limit; he recorded the requirement in today's quality notebook but has not yet attached it to the shutdown work order.

PF2.text: Priya confirmed with the dryer service technician that desiccant replacement requires 5 hours of isolation work followed by exactly 2 hours of pressure stabilization before production air can be released; the technician's estimate arrived by email this morning but has not yet been entered in the maintenance schedule.

PF3.text: Jonah confirmed that Line 5 can use its electrically actuated fixture during the air outage and produce exactly 240 units, provided the fixture setup is completed before the shutdown; he received the production trial result yesterday but has not updated the line plan.

PF4.text: Elena's pre-job safety review requires a two-person lockout verification covering exactly 4 isolation points before the dryer is opened; she completed the review this morning but has not signed the permit packet.

acceptance_conditions: The dryer replacement must be authorized.
The outage must be scheduled for exactly 7 hours.
Line 7 must not operate during the outage.
Line 5 must be assigned exactly 240 units through its electrically actuated fixture.
Compressed air must pass a restart test at a dew point of -40 degrees Celsius or lower.
The lockout plan must cover exactly 4 isolation points with two-person verification.
The quality requirement must be cited in the decision justification.

decisive_facts.why: The -40-degree-Celsius air requirement and the portable compressor's inability to meet it change Line 7's operating status to false and set the exact restart test limit to -40.
The technician's 5-hour isolation plus exactly 2-hour stabilization estimate changes the outage duration to exactly 7 hours.
The validated electrically actuated fixture changes Line 5's outage assignment to exactly 240 units.
The safety review changes the lockout plan to two-person verification of exactly 4 isolation points.
